title: Bloxy Swords
description: enhaces the sword size and thei apearence
body: In Minecraft, longswords are powerful, extended melee weapons typically introduced through popular combat mods like Spartan Weaponry, Tinkers' Construct, or Epic Fight, rather than the vanilla game. They trade off a slightly slower attack speed for increased reach and devastating raw damage, allowing players to keep hostile mobs at a safe distance. Many mods also grant the longsword a unique two-handed trait or a sweeping heavy attack that excels at crowd control, making it a favorite choice for players looking to upgrade their traditional sword-and-shield combat style.
